name: xyz.quantumatlas/food-hub
title: Quantum Atlas Destination Food Hub & Group Table
description: 15-tool dining MCP + ui://food/group-table App: live menus, dietary solver, 0%-fee restaurant ROI.

tools.name: food_list_destinations
tools.description:
Use this to list every destination served by the Quantum Atlas Global Food Hub with verified dining counts, structured menu coverage, statutory food tax rates, and per-city MCP URLs. Do not use this to search specific restaurants (use food_search_venues).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; auto-discovers all active Atlas destinations.

tools.name: food_search_venues
tools.description:
Use this to search publicly admitted restaurants, pubs, cafes, and bakeries by cuisine, dietary signal, or open_now status. Do not use this to load a venue's full dish list (use food_get_venue_menu) or search individual dishes across menus (use food_search_dishes).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; prospects excluded; never fabricates prices or hours.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

q.description: Free-text search keyword across venue name, cuisine, known_for, and top menu items.

orderable_only.description: When true, returns only venues with a direct ordering URL.

has_structured_menu.description: When true, returns only venues with a normalized JSON menu.

open_now.description: When true, returns only venues verified open at the evaluated timestamp.

max_price_cents.description: Maximum starting menu price ceiling in integer USD cents.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for deterministic open_now checks.

limit.description: Maximum venues to return (1 to 100; defaults to 25).

tools.name: food_get_venue_menu
tools.description:
Use this to retrieve one venue's normalized JSON menu (atlas.agent_menu.v2) with menu_sha256, O(1) dietary_index, topping/sauce customization_catalog, and integer-cent prices. Do not use this to price a group cart (use food_estimate_group_cart).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; unpriced items return price_cents: null rather than guessing.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

business_id.description: Verified venue business_id from food_search_venues (e.g. "slice-pizzeria-kdh" or "pickles-pub-ocmd").

exclude_allergens.description: Optional comma-separated allergen signals to exclude (e.g. "shellfish,peanut_tree_nut").

max_price_cents.description: Optional maximum item price filter in cents.

q.description: Optional item keyword filter within the menu.

tools.name: food_search_dishes
tools.description:
Use this to search individual menu items across all structured menus by dish keyword, dietary signal, allergen exclusions, or max_price_cents. Do not use this to browse venue-level metadata without menus (use food_search_venues).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; returns dish records sorted by price with variants and menu_sha256.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

max_price_cents.description: Maximum dish base price in integer USD cents.

priced_only.description: When true, excludes descriptive items without a published price.

open_now.description: When true, includes only dishes from venues verified open right now.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for deterministic open_now checks.

tools.name: food_discover_specials
tools.description:
Use this to fetch verified happy hours, late-night kitchen windows, group trays, and official venue offers. Do not use this for real-time 86'd items or tonight's live kitchen wait time (use food_get_kitchen_pulse).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; emits only provenance-backed entries with source URLs.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

tools.name: food_estimate_group_cart
tools.description:
Use this to price a known list of menu items with statutory food/alcohol tax rates, tip, per-seat splits, and a ready atlas.shared_surface.v1 table offer. Do not use this when dishes have not been chosen yet (use food_recommend_group_order).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; never auto-charges and refuses to invent prices for unpriced items (HTTP 422).

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

business_id.description: Verified venue business_id with a priced structured menu (e.g. "slice-pizzeria-kdh").

item_name.description: Menu item name or item_id from food_get_venue_menu.

quantity.description: Quantity of this item (1 to 50; defaults to 1).

variant_index.description: Zero-based size/variant index for multi-price items (e.g. 0 for 14" pie or individual salad, 1 for 16" pie or Tray feeds 4-6).

selected_choice.description: Optional required choice selection from item choice_options (e.g. wing sauce "Sweet Chili" or "Old Bay").

addons.description: Optional toppings or add-ons priced deterministically from the venue customization_catalog (e.g. ["pepperoni", "mushroom", "fresh basil"] or ["grilled chicken"]).

assigned_seat.description: Optional guest seat number (1 to 30) for per-seat split and atlas.shared_surface.v1 table placement.

notes.description: Optional preparation note (confirm severe allergies directly with the kitchen).

items.description: Line items to price from the venue structured menu.

party_size.description: Number of diners for equal per-person split math (defaults to 1).

tip_pct.description: Optional tip percentage applied to pre-tax subtotal (0 to 50).

include_shared_surface_offer.description: When true, includes a ready atlas.shared_surface.v1 multi-phone table offer payload.

tools.name: food_recommend_group_order
tools.description:
Use this to deterministically solve a multi-guest restaurant order where each seat has its own dietary rule, allergen exclusions, preference, and budget ceiling in cents. Do not use this when exact item names are already selected (use food_estimate_group_cart).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; verifies every constraint against menu_sha256 without LLM math errors.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

business_id.description: Optional target venue business_id; auto-selects the top priced-menu venue in the destination when omitted.

exclude_allergens.description: Allergen signals to exclude for this guest (e.g. ["shellfish", "peanut_tree_nut"]).

max_budget_cents.description: Maximum pre-tax item price ceiling in integer USD cents for this guest.

guests.description: Per-seat guest constraints (dietary, exclude_allergens, preference, max_budget_cents).

tip_pct.description: Tip percentage for the solved group basket (defaults to 18).

tools.name: food_merchant_onboarding_kit
tools.description:
Use this to calculate a restaurant's annual commission savings switching from 28% delivery apps to a Quantum Atlas Direct Anchor (2%-3%) and generate a consent-first onboarding manifest. Do not use this to parse raw menu text (use food_compile_structured_menu).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; generated manifest defaults to public_facts_ready: false until written owner consent.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

venue_name.description: Restaurant or venue name for the ROI model and manifest template.

monthly_delivery_orders.description: Estimated monthly third-party delivery orders (defaults to 400).

avg_order_usd.description: Average order subtotal in USD (defaults to 38).

tier.description: Atlas Merchant Anchor tier: starter ($49/mo), growth ($129/mo), or multi_venue ($299/mo).

tools.name: food_get_kitchen_pulse
tools.description:
Use this to read a venue's active Live Kitchen Pulse (86'd items, daily catch, and live kitchen wait time) or preview kitchen note parsing via dry_run_note. Do not use this to browse static recurring happy hours (use food_discover_specials).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; never fabricates wait times when no active pulse is present.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

dry_run_note.description: Optional natural-language kitchen note to parse in zero-mutation dry_run mode (e.g. "86 wings, fresh local rockfish tacos $19, wait 25m").

ttl_minutes.description: Optional TTL preview window in minutes when dry_run_note is supplied (defaults to 180).

tools.name: food_plan_time_window
tools.description:
Use this to evaluate whether a group can walk to a venue, wait, eat, and return within a strict door-to-door window (shore leave, ferry, or pre-show) including live kitchen wait and pickup fallback. Do not use this when no time cutoff applies (use food_search_venues).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; returns deterministic minute-by-minute timeline math and verdict.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

business_id.description: Optional target venue business_id; omit to rank all admitted food venues in the destination.

available_minutes.description: Total minutes available door-to-door before hard departure cutoff (15 to 720).

walking_minutes_one_way.description: One-way transit/walk time in minutes between dock/gate and venue (defaults to 8).

safety_buffer_minutes.description: Required safety margin in minutes before boarding/curtain cutoff (defaults to 15).

surge_minutes.description: Optional cruise-disembarkation or stadium-exit kitchen surge buffer in minutes (0 to 90).

cuisine.description: Optional cuisine filter when ranking venues across a destination.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for deterministic venue open-status checks.

include_parking.description: When true, attaches verified destination municipal & flood-resilient parking context.

items.description: Optional cart items to estimate alongside the time-window check.

item_name.description: Menu item name or item_id from food_get_venue_menu.

quantity.description: Quantity of this item (1 to 50; defaults to 1).

variant_index.description: Zero-based size/variant index for multi-price items (e.g. 0 for 14" pie or individual salad, 1 for 16" pie or Tray feeds 4-6).

selected_choice.description: Optional required choice selection from item choice_options (e.g. wing sauce "Sweet Chili" or "Old Bay").

addons.description: Optional toppings or add-ons priced deterministically from the venue customization_catalog (e.g. ["pepperoni", "mushroom", "fresh basil"] or ["grilled chicken"]).

assigned_seat.description: Optional guest seat number (1 to 30) for per-seat split and atlas.shared_surface.v1 table placement.

notes.description: Optional preparation note (confirm severe allergies directly with the kitchen).

tip_pct.description: Optional tip percentage for cart estimation (defaults to 18).

tools.name: food_compile_structured_menu
tools.description:
Use this to convert raw unstructured restaurant menu text, Markdown, HTML, or OCR lines into a normalized atlas.agent_menu.v2 JSON package ($0.10) with menu_sha256 and dietary_index. Do not use this to read an already onboarded venue's menu (use food_get_venue_menu for free).
Behavior: costs $0.10 via Stripe sbk_* spend key or Base USDC x402; never auto-publishes without written owner consent.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

raw_menu_text.description: Raw unstructured menu text, Markdown, HTML snippet, or OCR lines with section headings and item prices.

source_url.description: Optional official menu URL for provenance.

spend_key.description: Optional Stripe-funded master or delegated spend key (sbk_*) for paid attested execution. Also accepted via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

payment_signature.description: Optional Base Mainnet USDC x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value when paying with a crypto wallet instead of a Stripe spend key.

builder_code.description: Optional registered ERC-8021 partner builder_code for disclosed post-settlement revenue attribution (also accepted via x-atlas-builder-code header).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key for safe retries without double billing.

tools.name: food_attested_dining_brief
tools.description:
Use this to generate a paid ($0.05) dining execution brief combining venues, open status, specials, municipal parking, statutory taxes, and cart splits sealed with an Ed25519 JWS execution attestation. Do not use this for un-attested free browsing (use food_search_venues or food_preview_paid_tool).
Behavior: costs $0.05 via Stripe sbk_* spend key or Base USDC x402; unpaid calls return HTTP 402 requirements.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

budget_per_person_cents.description: Optional per-person menu budget ceiling in cents.

business_id.description: Optional specific venue business_id to price a cart or multilingual pack.

items.description: Optional cart items to estimate alongside the dining brief.

item_name.description: Menu item name or item_id from food_get_venue_menu.

quantity.description: Quantity of this item (1 to 50; defaults to 1).

selected_choice.description: Optional required choice selection from item choice_options (e.g. wing sauce "Sweet Chili" or "Old Bay").

addons.description: Optional toppings or add-ons priced deterministically from the venue customization_catalog (e.g. ["pepperoni", "mushroom", "fresh basil"] or ["grilled chicken"]).

assigned_seat.description: Optional guest seat number (1 to 30) for per-seat split and atlas.shared_surface.v1 table placement.

notes.description: Optional preparation note (confirm severe allergies directly with the kitchen).

tip_pct.description: Optional tip percentage for cart estimation (defaults to 18).

include_parking.description: When true, embeds destination municipal parking facilities.

languages.description: Optional Switchboard target languages for an embedded multilingual menu script.

spend_key.description: Optional Stripe-funded master or delegated spend key (sbk_*) for paid attested execution. Also accepted via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

payment_signature.description: Optional Base Mainnet USDC x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value when paying with a crypto wallet instead of a Stripe spend key.

builder_code.description: Optional registered ERC-8021 partner builder_code for disclosed post-settlement revenue attribution (also accepted via x-atlas-builder-code header).

tools.name: food_package_multilingual_menu
tools.description:
Use this to compile a venue's verified structured menu and destination glossary into a pronunciation-safe 11-language hospitality brief and Switchboard payload ($0.25) with Ed25519 JWS attestation. Do not use this for English-only menu reads (use food_get_venue_menu).
Behavior: costs $0.25 via Stripe sbk_* spend key or Base USDC x402; unpaid calls return HTTP 402 requirements.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.

max_items.description: Maximum featured menu items to include in the spoken script (defaults to 6).

include_allergen_disclaimer.description: When true, appends an explicit kitchen allergen confirmation notice.

spend_key.description: Optional Stripe-funded master or delegated spend key (sbk_*) for paid attested execution. Also accepted via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

payment_signature.description: Optional Base Mainnet USDC x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value when paying with a crypto wallet instead of a Stripe spend key.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key for safe retries without double billing.

tools.name: food_preview_paid_tool
tools.description:
Use this to run a deterministic zero-cost sandbox dry-run of any paid Food Hub capability (food_attested_dining_brief, food_package_multilingual_menu, or food_compile_structured_menu) before spending. Do not use this when you need a real Ed25519 JWS receipt.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge; returns deterministic sandbox preview and Stripe/x402 checkout hints.

capability_id.description: Paid Food Hub capability to preview with zero charge.

arguments.description: Optional arguments to validate against the capability schema.

tools.name: food_get_destination_snapshot
tools.description:
Use this to retrieve a single-hop, zero-auth, truth-gated Destination Visit Snapshot combining verified dining venues, structured menu counts, cultural/activity anchors, statutory tax rates, municipal policy watch, parking rules, and explicit readiness_flags. Do not use this to load one venue's full dish list (use food_get_venue_menu).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; prospects excluded; never fabricates prices or live parking space counts.

destination.description: Destination identifier slug (e.g. "annapolis", "ocean_city", "kill_devil_hills", "falmouth", "kingston"). Optional when connected to a per-destination endpoint like /food/annapolis/mcp.
